audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Ryze while both whys[0] and phases[0].why say the level is yours, and First item was 'Skill' while whys[5] says it flips to Ryze. Level 3 was also yours, which the mirror audit already resolved the other way.
audit.why: The mirror (audits/top/ryze__volibear.json) settled the chart as Volibear, Skill, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze. Restating it from this side keeps both pages consistent; mirror-fix.js would otherwise overwrite whatever I wrote here.
audit.corrected: Rows: Volibear, Skill, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze — paired across full and content, with ratings moved to match.

audit.why: Spikes read correctly: your levels 3-6 all-in pressure and two-item drain-tank, against Ryze's first mana item as his one clear zoning window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison was described flatly as 'his point-blank root'. Rune Prison only roots when Spell Flux is already on the target; without Flux it is a slow.
audit.why: That conditional is the whole matchup. If you are not carrying the Flux debuff, Rune Prison cannot stop Thundering Smash — it just slows you, and the stun still lands.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and roots only through Spell Flux (3.5s down to 2.5s, 615 range). Commit when Flux has expired off you.

audit.why: Riot's name is The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the full name plus Overload's real 5s cooldown.

edits.before: At level 3 your stun-into-stacks catches a mage with no dash.
edits.after: Level 3 is his — Flux makes Rune Prison a root that stops your Q.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Ryze under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: E completes your pattern, but level 3 is his: Spell Flux upgrades Rune Prison to a root, so hold Sky Splitter to shield the follow-up.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Ryze to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: His first mana item is his window: Rune Prison uptime and Overload poke zone you off. Farm it out and wait on your second item.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours: Ryze has no early mobility and a slow Overload (Q) cast, so you walk up behind minions, stack Relentless Storm, and threaten a Q stun he can't dash away from.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: Ryze has no early mobility and Overload is a 5s cooldown, so walk up behind minions, stack The Relentless Storm, and threaten a stun he cannot dash from.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: 11s at rank 1, and only a slow unless Spell Flux landed first — commit the moment the Flux debuff drops off you.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It only roots if Spell Flux is on you — step out of Flux and it is a slow you can walk through.

notes: Mirror (ryze__volibear) resolved the level chart differently from packet.levelChart, which gives Volibear rows 0-4 and 6. I followed the mirror as instructed. If the packet chart is the intended source of truth, both sides need re-running together.
